headlines.description: Arda Güler scored his third goal in five matches to fire Real Madrid to an eighth straight victory and move them level on points with Barcelona with a 3-0 win at Valencia.
headlines.shortLinkText: Güler inspires Real Madrid's 8th straight win to go level with Barcelona
